title: Accessible Chart Colours for NISRA
text: easiest way use nisracolours use scale_fill/colour_discrete_nisra() functions:
code: library(nisracolours) library(ggplot2) library(gapminder)  subset(gapminder, country %in% c("Germany", "France")) |>    ggplot(aes(year, gdpPercap, colour = country)) +   geom_line() +   scale_colour_discrete_nisra() +   theme_bw()
